name: Italy
notes: Italian lift passes are typical 6-day prices for the local area. Getting from Geneva to the Aosta Valley uses the Mont Blanc tunnel (toll).

locations.name: Courmayeur
locations.character: Smart, old mountain town under the Italian side of Mont Blanc. Long lunches, a lively evening street and big off-piste.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h20 through the Mont Blanc tunnel.

expert.note: Big off-piste, with the Skyway cable car to the Vallée Blanche and Toula glacier.

locations.name: La Thuile
locations.character: Quiet old mining village with a modern ski-in base, sharing its ski area with La Rosière in France.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h40 through the Mont Blanc tunnel.

links.note: Ski across the Petit-Saint-Bernard to La Rosière

park.note: A small park. La Rosière's park is on the same pass.

expert.note: Good off-piste and heli-skiing from the Rutor glacier.

locations.name: Pila
locations.easyStart: Beginner slopes beside the apartments at the top of the cable car.
locations.character: Sunny, purpose-built resort high above Aosta, reached by an 18-minute cable car from the city.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h. Train to Aosta, then the cable car up.

park.note: A well-known park with lines for beginners and improvers.

expert.note: Some off-piste with views of Mont Blanc and the Matterhorn.

locations.name: Cervinia
locations.easyStart: Wide, gentle slopes right above the village.
locations.snowNote: Glacier skiing up to 3,480 m keeps snow all season.
locations.character: High, snow-sure resort under the Matterhorn with long, easy runs and a ski link over the glacier to Zermatt.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h20. Train to Châtillon, then the bus up.

links.note: Ski over the Plateau Rosa glacier to Zermatt, on an international pass

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

expert.note: High off-piste and a glacier link to Zermatt.

locations.name: Valtournenche
locations.character: Real village below Cervinia, with lower prices and lifts up into the same ski area.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h10. Train to Châtillon, then the bus.

park.note: Small fun zones. Cervinia has the park.

expert.note: Long red runs, with Cervinia's high terrain above.

locations.name: Champoluc
locations.character: Pretty old village in the Ayas valley, the western gate to the Monterosa ski area and its famous off-piste.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h20. Car up the Ayas valley from Verrès.

expert.note: Some of the best off-piste in the Alps, best with a guide.

locations.name: Gressoney-La-Trinité
locations.character: Quiet Walser village of stone and wood in the middle of the Monterosa ski area.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h30. Car up the Gressoney valley from Pont-Saint-Martin.

links.note: Lifts over the Passo dei Salati

expert.note: Big off-piste towards Alagna and Champoluc.

locations.name: Alagna
locations.character: Small Walser village famous with freeriders, at the eastern end of the Monterosa ski area.
locations.transfer: Car about 2h from Milan Malpensa.

links.note: Lifts over the Passo dei Salati

park.note: No park. Alagna is about off-piste.

expert.note: Legendary freeride terrain from Punta Indren, best with a guide.

locations.name: Sestriere
locations.character: High, purpose-built Olympic resort at the heart of the Milky Way. Snow-sure, with skiing from the door.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Turin. Train to Oulx, then the bus.

park.note: A proper park with lines for each level.

expert.note: Steep Olympic runs and good off-piste.

locations.name: Sauze d'Oulx
locations.character: Old village with a famous party scene, long a British favourite, with tree-lined runs into the Milky Way.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Turin. Train to Oulx, then the bus.

park.note: A proper park with a beginner line.

locations.name: Sansicario
locations.character: Small, quiet ski-in ski-out spot in the middle of the Milky Way.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h20 from Turin.

links.note: Lifts across to Claviere and Montgenèvre

locations.name: Claviere
locations.character: Tiny border village a short walk from Montgenèvre, with lower Italian prices.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h20 from Turin.

links.note: Ski across the border to Montgenèvre

park.note: Small fun zones. Montgenèvre has the park.

locations.name: Bardonecchia
locations.character: Real mountain town with a train station, three separate ski areas and good prices.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h15 from Turin. Train to the town.

park.note: A well-known park with lines for each level.

locations.name: Livigno
locations.easyStart: Nursery slopes along the valley floor, a short walk from most hotels.
locations.character: Long, high valley town with tax-free shopping and snow-sure skiing on both sides. Host of Olympic freestyle events.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h30 from Bergamo.

park.note: Mottolino park is one of the best in Europe, with lines for every level and a halfpipe.

locations.name: Bormio
locations.character: Old Roman spa town with thermal baths and the steep Stelvio World Cup downhill.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 3h from Bergamo.

links.note: Free ski bus up the Valfurva

expert.note: The steep Stelvio run and long off-piste descents.

locations.name: Santa Caterina
locations.character: Small, quiet, snow-sure village at the end of the Valfurva, on the Bormio lift pass.
locations.transfer: Car about 3h15 from Bergamo.

locations.name: Madesimo
locations.character: Quiet village near the Swiss border, with the famous Canalone off-piste run.
locations.transfer: Car about 2h15 from Bergamo or Milan.

expert.note: The steep Canalone and good off-piste.

locations.name: Aosta
locations.character: Roman city with an old town, real shops and everyday prices. A cable car climbs from the station area to Pila.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h45 from Geneva through the Mont Blanc tunnel.

links.note: Cable car straight up to Pila

locations.name: Pré-Saint-Didier
locations.character: Small village with famous thermal baths, between Courmayeur and La Thuile.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Geneva.

locations.name: Morgex
locations.character: Quiet wine village below Courmayeur, with lower prices.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 1h30 from Geneva.

locations.name: Châtillon
locations.character: Valley town with a train station and buses up to Cervinia.
locations.transfer: Shared shuttle about 2h from Geneva.

locations.name: Pont-Saint-Martin
locations.character: Small town with a Roman bridge at the mouth of the Gressoney valley.
locations.transfer: Car about 1h45 from Milan Malpensa or Turin.

locations.name: Oulx
locations.character: Small town with the main station of the Milky Way, where the Paris to Milan TGV stops.
locations.transfer: Train from Turin about 1h. Car 1h.

locations.name: Susa
locations.character: Old Roman town lower down the valley, with low prices and trains to Turin.
locations.transfer: Train from Turin about 1h. Car 50 min.

locations.name: Tirano
locations.character: Valley town where the Bernina Express starts, with lower prices than Bormio and Livigno.
locations.transfer: Train from Milan about 2h30. Car from Bergamo 2h30.
